unlisted_practices: HHS should treat privacy-preserving techniques (differential privacy, federated learning with secure aggregation, strict data minimization) as expected controls for high-risk AI using longitudinal physiological data, requiring privacy-by-design plans and lifecycle monitoring in oversight.
CMS should link coverage or higher payment for AI-enabled CGM tools to documented use of privacy-preserving techniques and tight limits on secondary data use.
HHS should fund default use of privacy-preserving methods in multi-site CGM and automated insulin delivery research studies.
Adopt interoperability standards and shared data platforms to bridge data silos among diabetes device ecosystems.
